items.headline: What is voter roll-off and could it play a role in who wins the election this year?
items.detail: When the votes are finally tallied at the end of an election, it's normal to see the total number of votes cast in the races at the top of the ticket are slightly higher compared to the races at the bottom. It's known as voter roll-off.

items.headline: Live updates: Trump, Vance head to reliably red states to engage GOP base
